We are looking for a highly motivated **Data Scientist – AI Solutions** in our Control Tower team located in **Sugar Land, Texas**. The Data Scientist – AI Solutions will focus on developing practical AI\-enabled solutions, intelligent workflows, and agent\-based applications that accelerate business processes and digital transformation initiatives across the organization.


If you are a passionate professional that likes to work in an autonomous, hands\-on environment, we invite you to apply. This is your opportunity to join a growing company offering a competitive base salary and benefits.

**What’s in it For You:**

* The ability to make an impact and shape your career with a company that is passionate about growth
* The support of an organization that believes it is vital to include and engage diverse people, perspectives, and ideas to achieve our best
* Thrive in a company that values sustainability, and drives a safety\-focused culture
* Comprehensive benefits package starting day 1 of employment\- medical, dental, vision, matching 401k, and more!

**What You Will Do:**

* Develop AI\-enabled applications, intelligent workflows, and agent\-based solutions to improve business efficiency and accelerate decision\-making.
* Build and maintain scalable data pipelines, APIs, integrations, and automation workflows across multiple enterprise systems and data sources.
* Leverage modern AI\-assisted development workflows and automation tools to accelerate solution prototyping, code generation, testing, and deployment.
* Design and implement AI/ML workflows leveraging LLMs, embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, and orchestration frameworks.
* Prototype and deploy practical AI solutions supporting commercial, operational, product management, marketing, and technology organizations.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders to identify transformation opportunities and translate operational challenges into scalable digital solutions.
* Develop analytics\-ready datasets and structured data models to support AI applications, automation, and advanced business workflows.
* Support rapid experimentation, proof\-of\-concept development, testing, and continuous improvement of AI\-enabled solutions.
* Collaborate with technical teams, digital organizations, and business functions to ensure alignment, adoption, scalability, and long\-term sustainability of developed solutions.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Applied Mathematics, Chemical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering or related fields with 5\+ years of relevant experience; or Master’s degree with 3\+ years of relevant experience.
* Hands\-on experience developing AI/ML applications, intelligent automation solutions, or workflow orchestration systems.
* Strong programming and data engineering skills (Python, SQL, APIs, automation frameworks, data pipelines).
* Experience working with modern AI technologies including LLMs, embeddings, semantic search, vector databases, and agent\-based frameworks.
* Experience integrating and standardizing data from multiple enterprise systems and heterogeneous data sources.
* Strong problem\-solving skills with the ability to operate independently in fast\-moving environments.
* Ability to work across technical and business stakeholders to deliver practical and scalable solutions.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience developing agentic AI applications, copilots, or workflow automation tools.
* Experience using modern AI\-assisted software development and agentic coding tools within rapid prototyping or enterprise solution environments.
* Experience with cloud platforms, enterprise integrations, and AI application deployment.
* Experience with orchestration frameworks, automation platforms, or API\-based architectures.
* Familiarity with specialty chemicals, manufacturing, supply chain, commercial operations, or industrial business processes.
* Experience rapidly prototyping and deploying business\-focused AI solutions in enterprise environments.
* Understanding of data governance, security, and scalable AI solution design.
